Hana must be in slot 6 for the schedule to work, and the answer is the same as before.

Cara, Ben and Gus must all come before Hana, so Hana is in slot 4 or later. Checking each possible slot for Hana (4 through 8) leaves only slot 6. In that case Finn is in 7, Ann in 5 (exactly one person between Ann and Finn), and Dev in 9. Elif, Ivo, Cara, Gus and Ben then fill the remaining slots, and Cara and Gus must be 3 apart, which forces Cara into 1 and Gus into 4.

The note's second option (Ann in 4, Gus in 5) fails because Ann and Finn would be 3 slots apart, not 2.

I checked all 17 constraints against this order and each holds.
